card.text: M25 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 645 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), IC_4725: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 644.93549011 pc (16th to 84th percentile 644 to 645)
Wikipedia, "Messier 25"
sources.quote: Messier 25, also known as IC 4725, is an open cluster of stars in the southern constellation of Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M25 is drawn as 565 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: The first recorded observation of this cluster was made by Philippe Loys de Chéseaux in 1745 and it was included in Charles Messier's list of nebulous objects in 1764.
